T: The spice must flow. So must the snacks.
D: A young duke's son is sent with his family to rule the desert planet that holds the universe's most precious spice.
P: Serve the snacks when the Atreides land on Arrakis.
S: the spice that drifts across Arrakis
Flatbreads brushed with olive oil and baked at 220C until blistered, sprinkled with a dukkah of hazelnuts, sesame, cumin, coriander and cinnamon, labneh to dip.
the palm trees in the Arrakeen courtyard
Medjool dates split and stuffed with goat's cheese and a walnut, drizzled with honey and orange zest, on a board with dried apricots and figs.

Freshly shucked oysters on crushed ice with a mignonette of eschalot, red wine vinegar and cracked pepper, lemon wedges alongside. Finely dice 2 eschalots and mix with 80ml red wine vinegar, half a tsp cracked black pepper and a pinch of sugar. Rest for 15 minutes. Spread crushed ice over a large platter. Shuck 24 oysters, or buy them freshly shucked, and sit them on the ice, checking for any shell grit. Spoon a little mignonette over each and serve straight away with lemon wedges.
M: the long walk across the deep desert with the Fremen
Lamb shoulder browned and slow cooked 3 hours with onion, ras el hanout, saffron, apricots and chickpeas until tender, over herbed couscous.
House Atreides taking over the Arrakeen residence

Whole chicken rubbed with harissa, garlic and lemon, roasted golden and carved at the table with saffron rice, honey roast carrots and minted yoghurt. Rub a 1.8kg chicken with 3 tbsp harissa, 3 crushed garlic cloves, lemon zest, olive oil and salt. Roast at 200C for 75 minutes until the juices run clear. Toss 600g carrots with oil and 2 tbsp honey and roast alongside for 40 minutes. Soak a pinch of saffron in 500ml hot stock and cook 300g basmati in it, covered, for 12 minutes. Mix 200g yoghurt with chopped mint and serve.
W: the sandworm rising out of the dunes
Yeasted dough rolled with butter, brown sugar and cinnamon, cut into thick spirals, baked at 190C for 22 minutes, glazed with cardamom icing.
K: Every drop counts orange blossom cooler
water so precious Stilgar spits on the table as a sign of respect

Fresh orange and lemon juice with cardamom honey syrup and a drop of orange blossom water, topped with chilled water over ice and mint. Simmer 4 tbsp honey with 80ml water and 4 crushed cardamom pods for 3 minutes, then strain and cool. Squeeze 4 oranges and a lemon into a jug and stir in the syrup and half a tsp orange blossom water. Add 600ml chilled still water. Fill four glasses with ice, pour carefully so nothing is spilled and top each with mint and an orange slice.

s.note: the spice that drifts across Arrakis
s.how: Toast and pound 50g hazelnuts, 2 tbsp sesame seeds, 1 tsp cumin and a pinch of cinnamon with salt. Brush 4 flatbreads with oil and bake at 220C until blistered. Sprinkle with the dukkah and serve with 250g labneh.

s.note: the palm trees in the Arrakeen courtyard
s.how: Split 12 medjool dates, fill with goat's cheese and a walnut, and drizzle with honey and orange zest. Arrange on a board with 100g dried apricots and 100g dried figs.

m.note: the long walk across the deep desert with the Fremen
m.how: Brown 1.2kg diced lamb shoulder. Soften 2 onions with 2 tbsp ras el hanout and a pinch of saffron. Add 500ml water, 150g dried apricots and a tin of chickpeas and cook covered for 3 hours. Serve over 300g couscous with herbs.

w.note: the sandworm rising out of the dunes
w.how: Mix 400g flour, 7g yeast, 250ml warm milk and 50g butter and prove an hour. Roll out, spread with 60g butter, 80g brown sugar and cinnamon. Roll, cut thick spirals and bake at 190C for 22 minutes. Glaze with icing sugar and cardamom.
